materials.title: Urban Wetlands
materials.content_body: City planners once regarded small wetlands as unused land. A three-year local study found that restored channels helped some neighbourhoods hold storm water for longer. The researchers stressed that results depended on connected waterways and regular maintenance; planting trees alone was not enough.

materials.title: A Garden Experiment
materials.content_body: Two neighbourhoods tested rain gardens. In the second year both plant cover and rainfall changed. Researchers therefore could not attribute the change in drainage to one factor.

materials.title: A Soil Trial
materials.content_body: Scientists compared two soils in a greenhouse. One soil held more water, but the plants also received different amounts of light. The team said a further controlled trial was needed.

materials.title: A Bus Lane Trial
materials.content_body: A council tested bus lanes on two roads. Average journey times fell on weekdays, especially at peak hours. The report contained no weekend data.

materials.title: A Museum Survey
materials.content_body: A museum surveyed visitors during summer. Most respondents liked the new exhibition. Since the survey excluded winter visitors, it could not describe their views.

questions.prompt_text: What conditions did the wetland study identify?
questions.context_snippet:
A. More trees alone
B. Connected waterways and maintenance
C. Identical soil everywhere
D. Development of all wetlands
questions.answer_explanation: The answer is supported by the assigned passage.

candidate_error_mappings.evidence_summary: 选项 A 将增加树木当作充分条件；原文指出单独种树并不足够。
选项 A 可能忽略原文对湿地效果的条件限制，需要更多证据区分原因。

questions.prompt_text: Why did the researchers avoid a single explanation?
questions.context_snippet:
A. Both plant cover and rainfall changed
B. No observations were made
C. Only the soil changed
D. Both sites had identical weather
questions.answer_explanation: The answer is supported by the assigned passage.

questions.prompt_text: What is a reasonable conclusion from the soil trial?
questions.context_snippet:
A. Light had no possible effect
B. Another controlled trial is needed
C. Every soil holds the same water
D. The results prove a single cause
questions.answer_explanation: The answer is supported by the assigned passage.

questions.prompt_text: What can be concluded from the bus lane report?
questions.context_snippet:
A. Weekend journeys also became faster
B. Weekday average journeys became shorter
C. All roads need bus lanes
D. Peak times did not change
questions.answer_explanation: The answer is supported by the assigned passage.

questions.prompt_text: Which group was not included in the museum survey?
questions.context_snippet:
A. Winter visitors
B. Summer visitors
C. Exhibition visitors
D. Survey respondents
questions.answer_explanation: The answer is supported by the assigned passage.

materials.title: Library Notice
materials.content_body: For three Saturdays in June, Central Library will remain open until 8 p.m. Study rooms must be booked in advance. The book return box remains available after closing. The children’s area closes at 6 p.m.

materials.title: Volunteer Email
materials.content_body: The food distribution starts an hour earlier this week. Registered volunteers must reply by Thursday noon. Those who do not reply will not automatically receive a shift.

materials.title: Community Event
materials.content_body: New volunteers must attend a short briefing before their first shift. Returning volunteers may go directly to the reception desk.

materials.title: Evening Course
materials.content_body: The community centre’s photography course meets on Tuesdays. Participants can cancel for a refund before the first class. After the course starts, absent students can read handouts, but no replacement class is offered.

materials.title: Sports Centre Notice
materials.content_body: The swimming pool closes on Friday for repairs. The gym remains open. Members may use the pool at the nearby East Centre during the closure.

questions.prompt_text: What needs to be booked in advance?
questions.context_snippet:
A. The book return box
B. A study room
C. The library entrance
D. The children’s area
questions.answer_explanation: The answer is supported by the assigned passage.

candidate_error_mappings.evidence_summary: 选项 A 涉及还书箱，公告描述的是它在闭馆后的可用性。
选项 A 可能混淆公告中的用途和预约条件，需要更多证据区分原因。

questions.prompt_text: What happens if a registered volunteer does not reply?

B. A shift is guaranteed
C. The event is cancelled
D. The library closes
